hooks.name: warn-concurrent-sessions
hooks.description: Warn the agent when another live Kiro session uses the same working tree (docs/tooling/worktrees.md).

hooks.name: warn-concurrent-sessions-before-write
hooks.description: Ask the user once before a write or shell tool when another live Kiro session uses the same working tree, including sessions that started later (docs/tooling/worktrees.md).
